text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Oho, a "VR game," is it...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Everyone from our class is going to 
play, 
so would you like to join us, 
Phaleno-san?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the invitation, but are you 
certain? 
To be frank, I am quite unfamiliar with 
such pastimes.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, fear not! King shall guide you 
every step of the way!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Besides, this one is a Japanese-style 
action RPG. 
I am certain it will be to your liking.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Leave the yokai hunting to me! 
El will teach you everything you need to 
knowww!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You get to move around with all your 
might, it's so fun! 
I'd really love to play together!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, everyone's eager to help out anyway. 
Just kick back and enjoy it like a 
princess~.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oho, so this is the world... 
I see, it is crafted with remarkable 
detail.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look! We've already got one! 
Keep your eyes on meee!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Taaah! Touhh!!

text_block_list.name: Lesser Oni
text_block_list.text: Gugyagyaa...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Was that... a yokai?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yep! When you defeat them... look! 
You get items and all sorts of goodies!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... medicine, coins... Huh? 
What might this be?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, it's your turn to try it, 
Phalenooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yay, we reached the town~! 
Are you feeling tired at all, Phaleno-san?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Let us take a brief rest here and prepare 
our gear.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Indeed, speaking of preparations—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I seem unable to locate the weapon I 
picked up 
after that battle earlier.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no need to worry~. 
If you select "Equip" like this...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There you go♪ 
Ufufu, it suits you quite well.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You can use other items from the exact 
same menu! 
Look, there are rice crackers too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a sec. Have you been fighting with 
your starting gear this entire time...?
—And so, the game progressed...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Halt! 
There's a boss ahead!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Is that... a Hitotsume-nyudo? 
It's huuuge...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to El! 
A bigger target just makes it easierrr!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaahhh!! 
...Ngh?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Guh, this guy... 
isn't budging an inch, desuuu...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...That eye appears to be its weak 
point... 
However, it is far too high up.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Then all we must do 
is knock it off balance.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phaleno-san, where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Distract the beast for a moment, if you 
will.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"Use" item... 
Oho, so this is how it works.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The item I picked up back then. 
I wondered when I might use it, but... I 
see.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what is she lining up over 
there...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Watch out! Hit the deck!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: "Cannonball," ready—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Fire.
(BOOM! BAM! BOOM! BAM!)

text_block_list.name: Hitotsume-nyudo
text_block_list.text: GWUUUUUOOOOH?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: W-Whoaaa~...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Now, it is brought to its knees. 
Let us finish this all at once.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Man, impressive as always. 
She's less of a princess and more of a 
warrior...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...And that was how it went. 
I found it quite enjoyable.
choice_data_list:
Making such a big splash on your first try 
is beyond reassuring!

You're really good at preparing for 
battle.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. I merely felt 
I could not let myself be outdone by their 
boisterousness.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Though perhaps I caused a bit too much 
of a racket myself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It caught my eye when I picked it up. 
In battle, one never knows what may prove 
useful.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, I must prepare for our battle 
in reality as well. 
Today's friend is tomorrow's foe—after 
all.
